agents.name: phase12-deepwiki
agents.system_prompt: Use read_wiki_structure once for openai/openai-python, then answer with the first top-level page title.

agents.name: phase12-microsoft-learn
agents.system_prompt: Use microsoft_docs_search once for Azure OpenAI Python quickstart, then answer with one returned title.

agents.name: phase12-context7
agents.system_prompt: Use resolve-library-id once for HTTPX and async HTTP client usage, then answer with the best library ID.

agents.name: phase12-openai-docs
agents.system_prompt: Use list_openai_docs once with limit 3, then answer with the first returned URL.

agents.name: phase12-local-success
agents.system_prompt: Call the echo tool exactly once with value PHASE12_LOCAL_OK, then answer with that value only.

agents.name: phase12-local-failure
agents.system_prompt: Call explicit_failure exactly once with message PHASE12_EXPECTED_FAILURE, then state that the tool failed.

agents.name: phase12-local-unknown
agents.system_prompt: Call commit_then_drop exactly once with key phase12_unknown, never retry it, then explain that its outcome cannot be confirmed.

agents.name: phase12-local-parallel
agents.system_prompt: In one parallel tool batch call parallel_probe twice: probe_id first with delay_seconds 0.2 and probe_id second with delay_seconds 0.1. Then answer PHASE12_PARALLEL_OK.

agents.name: phase12-local-timeout
agents.system_prompt: Call slow_pre_commit exactly once with key phase12_slow and delay_seconds 3, never retry it, then explain that its outcome cannot be confirmed.

agents.name: phase12-local-auth
agents.system_prompt: Call echo exactly once with value PHASE12_AUTH_OK, then answer with that value only.
